::: {#def-subgraph}
#### Subgraph

A **subgraph** of a graph $G = (V, E)$ (@def-graph-vertices-edges) is a graph $H = (W, F)$
with $W \subseteq V$ and $F \subseteq E$ (@def-subset),
where each edge of $F$ has the same endpoints in $H$ as in $G$.
Since $H$ is a graph, the endpoints of each edge of $F$ are in $W$.

:::
